== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for Vader's Lightsaber: the entry “Vader's Lightsaber” in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'' Version 2.0 (November 1998), PDF page 135. Image for [[Vader's Lightsaber (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: wiki copy [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]]; archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf 20061215115652]. Cut unchanged from a 300 dpi render of the PDF page, around the entry's text block (clip p135:(176.0,598.9)-(499.1,646.2) points).
